scenes.summary: You find Hong Ni, the Qingbo Stockade resident who went missing. He also shares his explanations for the disturbances in the grove.

lines.text: Damn pirates! Wuling banned you leeches from waylaying travelers here, so now you're just here to cause trouble?! As if I'd buy your "oh we're just digging sprouts" crap!
Wha— How dare you frame me like this?! Hong Ni never lies! What I say is what I do, straight as a bamboo pole!
Let's not jump to accusations. Maybe there's a misunderstanding.
Oh, yeah! I've been trying to figure out how to leave this place!
Ugh. Big Bro taught me that all good fellows of the Stockade must respect the grove... And the grove will respect us in return. That's how we got along.
But for this nymphsprout dig, I found myself stumbling into a path I've never seen before! This ain't natural at all!
Did you break the thing next to the pool?
Oh? This looks like some Wuling contraption. Big Bro never told me about this.
And why is this machine even here? It's messing up with this piece of beautiful nature!
I guess you're blaming the Wuling Tianshi for the misbehaving grovenymphs?
Hurr. Accusations? You look pretty guilty. Bet you're hiding something!
I say we switch that Wuling gizmo off! Right now! The grove will return to normal once you Wulingers quit trying to change this turf!
The dastardly Tianshi of Wuling are plotting some major schemes again! Oooh. They're trying to get their dirty hands on our turf!
Hey, since when did you start siding with pirates?
Come on, pirate, stop making up random accusations...
*Hoo* ... *haa*... It's finally over! Thank Talos you got here on time...

options: Hong Ni, the entire Stockade is looking for you.

lines.text: Core W1 is up and running. And we just need to look for the last missing person.
Tianshi? I saw a figure headed to South Hill. Hollered as loud as I could but it just ignored me. Maybe it's a ghost!
South Hill... We need a raft to get there.

options: Where did that Tianshi Li Zhui mentioned go?
